noqa: BLE001 — a backend that can't even answer is treated as unavailable\n149\t            return False\n150\t\n151\t    # --- Layer 1: the owner-armed session ---------------------------------------------------------\n152\t    def arm(self, *, owner_key=None, ttl_seconds: float = 1800.0) -> Session:\n153\t        from ..governor.authn import signed_payload\n154\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_keypair\n155\t        ok = owner_key if owner_key is not None else (self._owner_key or owner_keypair())\n156\t        if ok is None:\n157\t            raise RuntimeError(\"cannot arm a gesture session without the owner key (BLOCK-3)\")\n158\t        sid = uuid.uuid4().hex\n159\t        core = {\"signal\": SESSION_ARMED, \"session_id\": sid}\n160\t        self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"OWNER\",\n161\t                          payload={**signed_payload(core, ok), \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\",\n162\t                                   \"ttl_seconds\": ttl_seconds,\n163\t                                   \"summary\": \"gesture session ARMED (indicator lit — opt-in)\"})\n164\t        self.session = Session(sid, live=True, expires_at=time.time() + ttl_seconds)\n165\t        return self.session\n166\t\n167\t    def disarm(self) -> None:\n168\t        if self.session is not None:\n169\t            self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"OWNER\",\n170\t                              payload={\"signal\": SESSION_DISARMED, \"session_id\": self.session.session_id,\n171\t                                       \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\", \"summary\": \"gesture session DISARMED\"})\n172\t            self.session.live = False\n173\t        self.session = None\n174\t\n175\t    # latency is bounded by the rescan floor, not a fixed TTL.\n263\t        if self._killswitch_engaged(time.time()):\n264\t            self.disarm()\n265\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": \"kill-switch engaged — session disarmed\"}\n266\t        if self.session is None or not self.session.live:\n267\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": \"no armed session — injection refused\"}\n268\t        if self.session.expired(time.time()):             # BLOCK-2: a session is bounded, never indefinite\n269\t            self.disarm()\n270\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": \"session expired — disarmed\"}\n271\t        tool = INTENT_TOOL.get(intent.kind)\n272\t        if tool is None:\n273\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": f\"unknown intent {intent.kind}\"}\n274\t        tier = self._cls().classify(tool)                 # DERIVED, fail-closed A3 on any error\n275\t        args = f\"{intent.dx:.4f},{intent.dy:.4f},{intent.arg}\"\n276\t        if tier <= Tier.A1:\n277\t            acted = self._backend_available()   # a platform SEAM (available()==False) is honestly inert\n278\t            self._inject(intent)                # an inert backend no-ops → NOTHING is physically injected\n279\t            # BLOCK-1: log the DISCRETE A1 injections that actually take effect (click/scroll/drag);\n280\t            # per-frame `move` is telemetry (logging it at 30 FPS would DoS the append-only spine).\n281\t            # SEAM-HONESTY: never let the audit log CLAIM an injection the backend didn't perform —\n282\t            # when the backend is inert, record honestly (`backend_inert: True`, \"NOT injected\"), and\n283\t            # return injected=False. The A2-queue path below is unchanged.\n284\t            if intent.kind != \"move\":\n285\t                payload = {\"signal\": ACTION_SIGNAL, \"decision\": \"auto\", \"tier\": tier.label(),\n286\t                           \"tool\": tool, \"session_id\": self.session.session_id,\n287\t                           \"summary\": (f\"gesture {tool} injected\" if acted\n288\t                                       else f\"gesture {tool} NOT injected — input backend inert (no-op)\")}\n289\t                if not acted:\n290\t                    payload[\"backend_inert\"] = True\n291\t                self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"OWNER\", payload=payload)\n292\t            verdict = {\"injected\": bool(acted), \"tier\": tier.label(), \"tool\": tool}\n293\t            if not acted:\n294\t                verdict[\"backend_inert\"] = True\n295\t                verdict[\"reason\"] = \"input backend inert — no physical injection performed\"\n296\t            return verdict\n297\t        # A2/A3 → QUEUE an approval bound to this exact action; inject NOTHING\n298\t        token = sha256_hex(f\"{self.session.session_id}|{tool}|{args}\".encode(\"utf-8\"))\n299\t        seq = self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"PERCEPTION\",\n300\t                                payload={\"signal\": ACTION_SIGNAL, \"decision\": \"queued\",\n301\t                                         \"status\": \"awaiting-approval\", \"tier\": tier.label(),\n302\t                                         \"tool\": tool, \"action_token\": token, \"args\": args,\n303\t                                         \"subject\": f\"gesture action {tool} (awaiting approval)\"})\n304\t        return {\"injected\": False, \"queued\": seq, \"tier\": tier.label(), \"tool\": tool, \"action_token\": token}\n305\t\n306\t    def _inject(self, intent: GestureIntent) -> None:\n307\t        b = self.backend\n308\t        if intent.kind == \"move\" or intent.kind == \"drag\":\n309\t            b.move(intent.dx, intent.dy)\n310\t        elif intent.kind == \"click\":\n311\t            b.click()\n312\t        elif intent.kind == \"scroll_left\":\n313\t            b.scroll(-1, 0)\n314\t        elif intent.kind == \"scroll_right\":\n315\t            b.scroll(1, 0)\n316\t"}]},"uuid":"51fa41e4-d39c-41e9-b698-6e697845215b","timestamp":"2026-07-19T10:35:38.064Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"801f8f28-c238-4a2e-80cb-f4dcb6786cd5","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

There is NO wire bearer\n5\tsecret: authentication IS the signature, verified against the owner-minted authorized-device set. This\n6\tmirrors the approval-record pattern (`agents.approvals._approval_message` / `verify_approval`) — same\n7\tcanonical-JSON message, same fail-closed `verify_one`, same trust pinned to owner-minted device keys\n8\t(a rogue/revoked device cannot self-authorize; a tampered field breaks the signature).\n9\t\n10\tReplay resistance is a deterministic, spine-anchored monotonic-nonce highwater PER DEVICE, enforced\n11\tATOMICALLY for EFFECTFUL requests: the check-then-receipt runs under the spine lock (re-entrant), so\n12\tconcurrent replays of one captured envelope can't both pass. An effectful request must carry a nonce\n13\tstrictly greater than the highest nonce that device has ever been receipted for. Reads are authenticated\n14\tby signature alone (the transport verifies them without a receipt and bounds their replay with a\n15\ttimestamp window). The receipt is an append-only spine event, so the watermark is tamper-evident memory.\n16\t\n17\tThis module is PURE by construction — NO wallclock, NO RNG. The caller supplies `nonce` and `ts` so the\n18\tJS phone client and Python reproduce the exact signed bytes (the parity contract) and so freshness is a\n19\tdeterministic function of the spine. A wallclock timestamp-WINDOW check (is `ts` recent?) belongs to\n20\tthe server transport layer, not here. Offense-free.\"\"\"\n21\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n22\t\n23\tfrom typing import Set, Tuple, Union\n24\t\n25\tfrom ..reuse import canonical_json, sign, verify_one\n26\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n27\t\n28\t# The request vocabulary the bridge accepts — a fail-closed allow-list. `panic`/`relay` are effectful;\n29\t# the `read:*` family is side-effect-free. An action outside this set is refused even if validly signed.\n30\tACTIONS = frozenset({\"panic\", \"relay\", \"read:snapshot\", \"read:pending\", \"read:record\",\n31\t                     \"read:stream\", \"read:recall\"})\n32\t\n33\t# The spine signal marking a consumed request. Its records form the per-device nonce highwater.\n34\tRECEIPT_SIGNAL = \"mesh.request\"\n35\t\n36\t\n37\tdef envelope_message(core: dict) -> bytes:\n38\t    \"\"\"The exact bytes signed/verified — canonical JSON of the core. This is the JS<->Python parity\n39\t    contract: a future JS client MUST produce these identical bytes. Mirrors\n40\t    `agents.approvals._approval_message` (return bytes; encode only if `canonical_json` gave a str).\"\"\"\n41\t    m = canonical_json(core)\n42\t    return m if isinstance(m, bytes) else m.encode()\n43\t\n44\t\n45\tdef build_core(device_pubkey: str, action: str, args: dict, nonce, ts) -> dict:\n46\t    \"\"\"The signed core. `nonce`/`ts` are caller-supplied (this module never reads a clock or RNG).\"\"\"\n47\t    return {\"v\": 1, \"device\": device_pubkey, \"action\": action, \"args\": args, \"nonce\": nonce, \"ts\": ts}\n48\t\n49\t\n50\tdef sign_envelope(device_key, core: dict) -> dict:\n51\t    \"\"\"Phone/test side: attach a DEVICE signature over the canonical core, producing the wire payload.\"\"\"\n52\t    return {**core, \"sig\": sign(device_key.private_key_b64, envelope_message(core))}\n53\t\n54\t\n55\tdef verify_envelope(payload, authorized: Set[str]) -> Tuple[bool, Union[dict, str]]:\n56\t    \"\"\"Fail-closed authentication. Rebuild the core (payload minus `sig`); refuse if there is no sig /\n57\t    no device / the device is not in the owner-minted authorized set; then Ed25519-verify the signature\n58\t    over the canonical core; finally require the (now-authenticated) action to be in the `ACTIONS`\n59\t    allow-list. Mirrors `agents.approvals.verify_approval`. Returns (True, core) or (False, reason).\"\"\"\n60\t    p = payload.payload if hasattr(payload, \"payload\") else payload\n61\t    sig = p.get(\"sig\")\n62\t    device = p.get(\"device\")\n63\t    if not sig or not device or not isinstance(device, str):   # a non-str device would crash the `in authorized` set test\n64\t        return False, \"missing/invalid signature or device\"\n65\t    if device not in authorized:                       # trust pinned to owner-minted device keys\n66\t        return False, \"device is not authorized\"\n67\t    core = {k: v for k, v in p.items() if k != \"sig\"}\n68\t    try:                                               # verify_one RAISES on a malformed-length sig\n69\t        sig_ok = verify_one(device, envelope_message(core), sig)\n70\t    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — any crypto/decode error is a fail-closed refusal, never a crash\n71\t        return False, \"signature invalid\"\n72\t    if not sig_ok:\n73\t        return False, \"signature invalid\"\n74\t    if core.get(\"action\") not in ACTIONS:              # allow-list the authenticated action (fail-closed)\n75\t        return False, f\"unknown action: {core.get('action')!r}\"\n76\t    return True, core\n77\t\n78\t\n79\tdef record_receipt(store: SpineStore, core: dict) -> int:\n80\t    \"\"\"Append the append-only consumption receipt. Carries only the routing fields — never `args`\n81\t    (which may hold a subject) and never the signature; the record is auto-tier (an A0 event).\"\"\"\n82\t    return store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"DEVICE\",\n83\t                        payload={\"signal\": RECEIPT_SIGNAL, \"device\": core[\"device\"],\n84\t                                 \"action\": core[\"action\"], \"nonce\": core[\"nonce\"],\n85\t                                 \"ts\": core[\"ts\"], \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"})\n86\t\n87\t\n88\tdef device_nonce_highwater(store: SpineStore, device_pubkey: str) -> int:\n89\t    \"\"\"The highest receipted nonce for this device (-1 if none, so a first nonce of 0 is valid). Non-int\n90\t    nonces are tolerated (skipped).\"\"\"\n91\t    hi = -1\n92\t    for r in store.iter_records():\n93\t        p = r.payload\n94\t        if p.get(\"signal\") == RECEIPT_SIGNAL and p.get(\"device\") == device_pubkey:\n95\t            try:\n96\t                n = int(p.get(\"nonce\"))\n97\t            except (TypeError, ValueError):\n98\t                continue\n99\t            if n > hi:\n100\t                hi = n\n101\t    return hi\n102\t\n103\t\n104\tdef consume(store: SpineStore, payload, authorized: Set[str], *, effectful: bool) -> dict:\n105\t    \"\"\"Authenticate, gate replay for effectful requests, receipt, return the core. Raises `ValueError`\n106\t    with the refusal reason on any failure (fail-closed). An effectful request requires a nonce strictly\n107\t    fresher than this device's highwater; a read skips that gate but still receipts (advancing it).\"\"\"\n108\t    ok, core = verify_envelope(payload, authorized)\n109\t    if not ok:\n110\t        raise ValueError(core)\n111\t    n_raw = core.get(\"nonce\")\n112\t    if isinstance(n_raw, float) and n_raw != n_raw:        # NaN (n != n) — canonical-json serializes it, so guard here\n113\t        raise ValueError(\"invalid nonce\")\n114\t    try:\n115\t        nonce = int(n_raw)                                 # int(inf) raises OverflowError (NOT a ValueError) — catch it\n116\t    except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):\n117\t        raise ValueError(\"invalid nonce\")\n118\t    if nonce < 0:\n119\t        raise ValueError(\"invalid nonce\")\n120\t    if effectful:\n121\t        # ATOMIC check-then-receipt: hold the re-entrant spine lock across the highwater read AND the\n122\t        # receipt append, so two concurrent replays of one captured envelope can't both pass (TOCTOU).\n123\t        from ..spine.store import spine_lock\n124\t        with spine_lock(store.path):\n125\t            if nonce <= device_nonce_highwater(store, core[\"device\"]):\n126\t                raise ValueError(\"replay: nonce not fresh\")\n127\t            record_receipt(store, core)\n128\t    else:\n129\t        record_receipt(store, core)\n130\t    return core\n131\t"}]},"uuid":"c7a47f32-50d6-4262-934e-bd38e20b4718","timestamp":"2026-07-19T10:36:25.341Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d09f0a1a-19e0-431d-95e5-072bf2eaca51","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"489ea33c-41cb-4c17-8d4e-4f22c1803f16","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"6d6f6da1-0dda-49ba-98c2-ecb094db874a","agentId":"a623e408ac773fafe","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01E8UhCig9UQyXvFm1MaLgQ1","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"The SIGIL bridge server (Phase 9 W1-B) — the WireGuard-bound HTTP transport that lets an\n2\tAUTHORIZED phone reach the desktop `BridgeDaemon`. It forks the WS-C glass-cockpit server\n3\t(`sigil.ui.server`) verbatim in shape (ThreadingHTTPServer + BaseHTTPRequestHandler, the strict\n4\tCSP/nosniff/no-referrer header set, the body cap + 30s timeout, the never-log-auth `log_message`,\n5\tthe SSE structure, the anti-DNS-rebinding Host/Origin/Referer gate) and changes ONLY three things:\n6\t\n7\t  • THE BIND. It binds a `bind_ok` address (loopback or a PRIVATE/WireGuard address) — NEVER\n8\t    0.0.0.0 / a public address. The constructor asserts this; the CLI asserts it too. This is the\n9\t    non-negotiable exposure guard: the tunnel, not the transport, is the network boundary.\n10\t\n11\t  • THE AUTH. There is NO wire bearer secret (the ui's printed token is gone). Authentication IS a\n12\t    per-request Ed25519 signature the phone makes with ITS OWN owner-authorized device key — the\n13\t    Wave-1 device envelope (`bridge.envelope`). The server verifies the signature against the\n14\t    owner-minted authorized-device set (recomputed PER REQUEST so a revocation takes effect at once),\n15\t    binds the authenticated envelope `action` to the endpoint it hit (a `read:pending` envelope can\n16\t    never reach the more-sensitive `read:recall`), applies a wallclock timestamp-freshness window\n17\t    (injectable clock), and for EFFECTFUL actions (panic/relay) additionally runs the envelope's\n18\t    strict monotonic-nonce replay gate (`consume(effectful=True)`). The owner trust-root is NEVER used\n19\t    to sign anything here — the phone signs, the server only verifies.\n20\t\n21\t  • THE ALLOWLIST. The anti-rebind Host/Origin allowlist is derived from the REAL bound address (plus\n22\t    the loopback pair when bound to loopback, for dev), not a hardcoded 127.0.0.1.\n23\t\n24\tEverything sensitive stays off the minimal frames: `/api/pending` and the SSE stream carry only\n25\t`{seq, tier, kind}` — never a subject, never a payload, never a secret. `serve()` now wraps the\n26\ttransport in an owner-PINNED self-signed TLS cert (the phone PWA needs a secure context — https or\n27\tlocalhost — to install and register a service worker; over a bare WireGuard IP that means self-signed\n28\tTLS whose sha256 fingerprint the owner pins once, stable across restarts). `build_server` itself\n29\tstays plain HTTP so the in-tunnel test harness is unchanged and TLS can be terminated upstream if\n30\tpreferred. Offense-free.\"\"\"\n31\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n32\t\n33\timport base64\n34\timport ipaddress\n35\timport json\n36\timport logging\n37\timport os\n38\timport time\n39\tfrom http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer\n40\tfrom pathlib import Path\n41\tfrom urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse\n42\t\n43\tfrom ..config import SPINE_PATH\n44\tfrom ..governor.identity import owner_pubkey\n45\tfrom ..mesh import authorized_devices\n46\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n47\tfrom ..spine.verify import verify_record\n48\tfrom .daemon import BridgeDaemon, bind_ok\n49\tfrom .envelope import consume, verify_envelope\n50\tfrom .notifier import PushNotifier\n51\t\n52\t_WEBAPP = Path(__file__).parent / \"webapp\"       # the PWA is a later slice — served if present, else 404\n53\t_CSP = \"default-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'\"\n54\t_DEFAULT_PORT = 8722\n55\t\n56\t# Operational audit trail for a NETWORK-FACING daemon: accepted effectful actions (INFO) and denials\n57\t# (WARNING) go here so an operator can answer \"who did what\" — WITHOUT ever leaking a credential. We\n58\t# log a device pubkey PREFIX only (never the full key), and NEVER the envelope / signature / token /\n59\t# secret / request body. The stdlib access log (`log_message`) stays suppressed for exactly that\n60\t# reason (an envelope can ride in `?env=`); this logger is the operable substitute. Emits only if the\n61\t# host app configures logging (INFO stays silent by default; WARNING surfaces via lastResort).\n62\t_log = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n63\t_PUBKEY_LOG_PREFIX = 12                           # chars of a device pubkey we log — enough to correlate, not the key\n64\t\n65\t\n66\tdef _pk_prefix(pubkey) -> str:\n67\t    \"\"\"A short, non-reversible tag for a device pubkey (prefix only — NEVER the full key in a log).\"\"\"\n68\t    s = str(pubkey) if pubkey else \"\"\n69\t    return (s[:_PUBKEY_LOG_PREFIX] + \"…\") if s else \"?\"\n70\t_TS_WINDOW = 120.0                               # ± seconds a request timestamp may differ from the server clock\n71\t\n72\t# Each network endpoint declares the ONE envelope action that authorizes it. Binding the\n73\t# authenticated action to the endpoint stops a captured lesser-scoped envelope (e.g. `read:pending`,\n74\t# which leaks only {seq,tier,kind}) from being replayed against a more-sensitive endpoint (e.g.\n75\t# `read:recall`, which surfaces the owner's on-screen OCR history). `/api/graph` piggybacks on the\n76\t# `read:snapshot` scope: graph returns only aggregate health, strictly LESS sensitive than the\n77\t# snapshot, so a snapshot-scoped envelope reaching it is not an escalation (and a lesser envelope\n78\t# still cannot reach it).\n79\t_READ_ACTION = {\n80\t    \"/api/pending\": \"read:pending\",\n81\t    \"/api/snapshot\": \"read:snapshot\",\n82\t    \"/api/graph\": \"read:snapshot\",\n83\t    \"/api/stream\": \"read:stream\",\n84\t    \"/api/recall\": \"read:recall\",\n85\t}\n86\t\n87\t\n88\tclass BridgeServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):\n89\t    daemon_threads = True\n90\t\n91\t    def __init__(self, addr, handler, *, spine_path, trusted_pubkey=None, clock=None,\n92\t                 ts_window: float = _TS_WINDOW):\n93\t        host = addr[0]\n94\t        if not bind_ok(host):\n95\t            raise ValueError(\n96\t                f\"refusing to bind {host!r}: the bridge binds loopback or a PRIVATE (WireGuard) \"\n97\t                f\"address only — never 0.0.0.0 / an unspecified / a public address\")\n98\t        super().__init__(addr, handler)\n99\t        self.spine_path = Path(spine_path)\n100\t        # the owner PUBLIC key is the trust anchor (injectable for tests); NO private key ever lives here\n101\t        self.trusted_pubkey = trusted_pubkey if trusted_pubkey is not None else owner_pubkey()\n102\t        self.clock = clock or time.time          # injectable wallclock so the freshness gate is deterministic\n103\t        self.ts_window = ts_window\n104\t        port = self.server_address[1]            # the ACTUAL bound port (correct even for port 0)\n105\t        hosts = {f\"{host}:{port}\"}\n106\t        origins = {f\"http://{host}:{port}\"}\n107\t        if ipaddress.ip_address(host).is_loopback:   # dev convenience only — not added for a WG bind\n108\t            hosts |= {f\"127.0.0.1:{port}\", f\"localhost:{port}\"}\n109\t            origins |= {f\"http://127.0.0.1:{port}\", f\"http://localhost:{port}\"}\n110\t        self.allowed_hosts = frozenset(hosts)\n111\t        self.allowed_origins = frozenset(origins)\n112\t\n113\t    def store(self) -> SpineStore:\n114\t        return SpineStore(self.spine_path)       # fresh read each request (cheap, current)\n115\t\n116\t    def daemon(self) -> BridgeDaemon:\n117\t        return BridgeDaemon(self.store(), trusted_pubkey=self.trusted_pubkey)\n118\t\n119\t\n120\tdef _json_bytes(obj) -> bytes:\n121\t    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False).encode(\"utf-8\")\n122\t\n123\t\n124\tclass Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):\n125\t    server_version = \"sigil-bridge/1.0\"\n126\t    timeout = 30                                  # per-connection socket timeout (no hung reader)\n127\t    _MAX_BODY = 65536                             # bodies are tiny; cap to avoid a Content-Length hang/alloc\n128\t\n129\t    # never log auth (an envelope can ride in ?env= for SSE; never write it to a log)\n130\t    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):  # noqa: A003\n131\t        pass\n132\t\n133\t    # --- request helpers --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n134\t    def _query(self) -> dict:\n135\t        return parse_qs(urlparse(self.path).query)\n136\t\n137\t    def _authorized_now(self):\n138\t        \"\"\"The owner-minted authorized-device set, recomputed PER REQUEST — a revoke takes effect now.\"\"\"\n139\t        return authorized_devices(self.server.store(), self.server.trusted_pubkey)\n140\t\n141\t    def _envelope_payload(self):\n142\t        \"\"\"The device envelope: base64url of canonical JSON, in `X-SIGIL-Envelope` (GET/POST) or the\n143\t        `?env=` query (SSE, which cannot set a header). Returns the payload dict, or None if absent/\n144\t        malformed (fail-closed — the caller denies).\"\"\"\n145\t        raw = self.headers.get(\"X-SIGIL-Envelope\") or (self._query().get(\"env\", [\"\"])[0])\n146\t        if not raw:\n147\t            return None\n148\t        try:\n149\t            data = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(raw + \"=\" * (-len(raw) % 4))\n150\t            payload = json.loads(data)\n151\t        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — any decode/parse failure is an unauthenticated request\n152\t            return None\n153\t        return payload if isinstance(payload, dict) else None\n154\t\n155\t    def _fresh(self, core) -> bool:\n156\t        \"\"\"The server-layer wallclock freshness window (the envelope module is pure — it never reads a\n157\t        clock — so freshness lives HERE). A non-numeric / far-off timestamp fails closed.\"\"\"\n158\t        try:\n159\t            ts = float(core.get(\"ts\"))\n160\t        except (TypeError, ValueError):\n161\t            return False\n162\t        return abs(self.server.clock() - ts) <= self.server.ts_window\n163\t\n164\t    def _authed(self, action: str):\n165\t        \"\"\"Authenticate a READ: verify the device signature, apply freshness, bind the action to this\n166\t        endpoint. Reads are side-effect-free, so they are NOT receipted (no spine write per GET) — the\n167\t        freshness window is their replay bound. Returns the core, or None after sending a deny.\"\"\"\n168\t        payload = self._envelope_payload()\n169\t        if payload is None:\n170\t            self._deny(401, \"missing/invalid device envelope\")\n171\t            return None\n172\t        ok, core = verify_envelope(payload, self._authorized_now())\n173\t        if not ok:\n174\t            self._deny(401, f\"unauthenticated: {core}\")\n175\t            return None\n176\t        if not self._fresh(core):\n177\t            self._deny(401, \"stale request (timestamp outside freshness window)\")\n178\t            return None\n179\t        if core.get(\"action\") != action:\n180\t            self._deny(403, \"envelope action does not authorize this endpoint\")\n181\t            return None\n182\t        return core\n183\t\n184\t    def _authed_effectful(self, action: str):\n185\t        \"\"\"Authenticate an EFFECTFUL request (panic/relay): verify + freshness + endpoint-bind, then run\n186\t        the envelope's strict monotonic-nonce replay gate and receipt it on the spine\n187\t        (`consume(effectful=True)`). A replayed/stale-nonce envelope is refused. Returns core or None.\"\"\"\n188\t        payload = self._envelope_payload()\n189\t        if payload is None:\n190\t            self._deny(401, \"missing/invalid device envelope\")\n191\t            return None\n192\t        authorized = self._authorized_now()\n193\t        ok, core = verify_envelope(payload, authorized)\n194\t        if not ok:\n195\t            self._deny(401, f\"unauthenticated: {core}\")\n196\t            return None\n197\t        if not self._fresh(core):\n198\t            self._deny(401, \"stale request (timestamp outside freshness window)\")\n199\t            return None\n200\t        if core.get(\"action\") != action:\n201\t            self._deny(403, \"envelope action does not authorize this endpoint\")\n202\t            return None\n203\t        try:\n204\t            return consume(self.server.store(), payload, authorized, effectful=True)\n205\t        except ValueError as e:                   # replay / invalid nonce (fail-closed)\n206\t            self._deny(409, f\"refused: {str(e)[:120]}\")\n207\t            return None\n208\t        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 — never let a consume error crash the handler (no RemoteDisconnected)\n209\t            self._deny(400, f\"refused: {type(e).__name__}\")\n210\t            return None\n211\t\n212\t    def _rebind_ok(self) -> bool:\n213\t        \"\"\"The anti-DNS-rebinding gate (ui `_action_ok` logic, minus the token — the envelope is the\n214\t        credential): the `Host` must be in the WG-derived allowlist, an `Origin`, if present, must\n215\t        EXACT-match an allowed origin (a prefix like `http://IP:PORT.evil.com` must NOT pass), and a\n216\t        `Referer`, if present, must sit under an allowed origin. Applied to the whole POST action\n217\t        plane as defense-in-depth.\"\"\"\n218\t        if self.headers.get(\"Host\", \"\") not in self.server.allowed_hosts:\n219\t            return False\n220\t        o = self.headers.get(\"Origin\") or \"\"\n221\t        ref = self.headers.get(\"Referer\") or \"\"\n222\t        if o and o not in self.server.allowed_origins:\n223\t            return False\n224\t        if ref and not any(ref.startswith(a + \"/\") or ref == a for a in self.server.allowed_origins):\n225\t            return False\n226\t        return True\n227\t\n228\t    # --- response helpers -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n229\t    def _send(self, code: int, body: bytes, ctype=\"application/json\"):\n230\t        self.send_response(code)\n231\t        self.send_header(\"Content-Type\", ctype)\n232\t        self.send_header(\"Content-Length\", str(len(body)))\n233\t        self.send_header(\"Content-Security-Policy\", _CSP)\n234\t        self.send_header(\"X-Content-Type-Options\", \"nosniff\")\n235\t        self.send_header(\"Referrer-Policy\", \"no-referrer\")\n236\t        self.end_headers()\n237\t        try:\n238\t            self.wfile.write(body)\n239\t        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):\n240\t            pass\n241\t\n242\t    def _json(self, obj, code=200):\n243\t        self._send(code, _json_bytes(obj))\n244\t\n245\t    def _deny(self, code=403, msg=\"forbidden\"):\n246\t        # WARNING-level audit of every denial: method, PATH ONLY (never the query — an envelope can ride\n247\t        # in `?env=`), status, and the developer-controlled reason. `msg` is a fixed reason string, never\n248\t        # the envelope/signature/token/secret/body.\n249\t        _log.warning(\"bridge denied: %s %s -> %d (%s)\",\n250\t                     getattr(self, \"command\", \"?\"), urlparse(self.path).path, code, msg)\n251\t        self._json({\"error\": msg}, code)\n252\t\n253\t    # --- GET (read plane) -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n254\t    def do_GET(self):\n255\t        path = urlparse(self.path).path\n256\t        if path in (\"/\", \"/index.html\"):\n257\t            return self._serve_index()\n258\t        if path.startswith(\"/static/\"):\n259\t            return self._serve_static(path[len(\"/static/\"):])\n260\t        if not path.startswith(\"/api/\"):\n261\t            return self._deny(404, \"not found\")\n262\t        if path == \"/api/stream\":\n263\t            return self._sse()                    # SSE authenticates via ?env= inside _authed\n264\t        if path == \"/api/pending\":\n265\t            if self._authed(_READ_ACTION[path]) is None:\n266\t                return\n267\t            return self._json({\"pending\": self.server.daemon().pending()})   # {seq,tier,kind} only\n268\t        if path == \"/api/snapshot\":\n269\t            if self._authed(_READ_ACTION[path]) is None:\n270\t                return\n271\t            from ..dashboard import snapshot\n272\t            return self._json(snapshot(self.server.store()))\n273\t        if path == \"/api/graph\":\n274\t            if self._authed(_READ_ACTION[path]) is None:\n275\t                return\n276\t            return self._graph()\n277\t        if path.startswith(\"/api/record/\"):\n278\t            if self._authed(\"read:record\") is None:\n279\t                return\n280\t            return self._record(path.rsplit(\"/\", 1)[-1])\n281\t        if path == \"/api/recall\":\n282\t            if self._authed(_READ_ACTION[path]) is None:\n283\t                return\n284\t            subject = self._query().get(\"subject\", [\"\"])[0]\n285\t            return self._json({\"subject\": subject, \"recall\": self.server.daemon().recall(subject)})\n286\t        return self._deny(404, \"unknown endpoint\")\n287\t\n288\t    def _serve_index(self):\n289\t        idx = _WEBAPP / \"index.html\"\n290\t        if not idx.is_file():\n291\t            return self._deny(404, \"bridge PWA not built yet\")   # graceful — the webapp is a later slice\n292\t        try:\n293\t            self._send(200, idx.read_bytes(), ctype=\"text/html; charset=utf-8\")\n294\t        except OSError:\n295\t            self._deny(404, \"not found\")\n296\t\n297\t    def _serve_static(self, sub: str):\n298\t        base = _WEBAPP.resolve()\n299\t        target = (base / sub).resolve()\n300\t        if base != target and base not in target.parents:        # traversal guard (allowlist by containment)\n301\t            return self._deny(404, \"not found\")\n302\t        if not target.is_file():\n303\t            return self._deny(404, \"not found\")                  # includes: webapp dir absent (later slice)\n304\t        name = target.name\n305\t        ctype = (\"application/javascript\" if name.endswith(\".js\")\n306\t                 else \"text/css\" if name.endswith(\".css\")\n307\t                 else \"text/html\" if name.endswith(\".html\")\n308\t                 else \"application/octet-stream\")\n309\t        try:\n310\t            self._send(200, target.read_bytes(), ctype=f\"{ctype}; charset=utf-8\")\n311\t        except OSError:\n312\t            self._deny(404, \"not found\")\n313\t\n314\t    def _record(self, raw):\n315\t        try:\n316\t            seq = int(raw)\n317\t        except ValueError:\n318\t            return self._deny(400, \"bad seq\")\n319\t        rec = self.server.store().get(seq)\n320\t        if rec is None:\n321\t            return self._json({\"error\": \"no such record\", \"seq\": seq,\n322\t                               \"note\": \"no grounded record — not fabricated\"}, 404)\n323\t        ok, reason = verify_record(rec)                          # re-verify the atom LIVE (prove-don't-guess)\n324\t        self._json({\"seq\": rec.seq, \"kind\": rec.kind, \"source\": rec.source, \"actor\": rec.actor,\n325\t                    \"ts\": rec.ts, \"entry_hash\": rec.entry_hash, \"prev_hash\": rec.prev_hash,\n326\t                    \"payload\": rec.payload, \"integrity_ok\": ok, \"integrity_reason\": reason})\n327\t\n328\t    def _graph(self):\n329\t        try:\n330\t            from ..graph import health\n331\t            self._json({\"health\": health()})\n332\t        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 — graph may not be built yet (ImportError included)\n333\t            self._json({\"error\": \"graph unavailable\", \"note\": str(e)[:200]})\n334\t\n335\t    def _sse(self):\n336\t        if self._authed(\"read:stream\") is None:                  # deny already sent (401/403)\n337\t            return\n338\t        self.send_response(200)\n339\t        self.send_header(\"Content-Type\", \"text/event-stream\")\n340\t        self.send_header(\"Cache-Control\", \"no-cache\")\n341\t        self.send_header(\"Content-Security-Policy\", _CSP)\n342\t        self.send_header(\"X-Content-Type-Options\", \"nosniff\")\n343\t        self.send_header(\"Referrer-Policy\", \"no-referrer\")\n344\t        self.end_headers()\n345\t        try:\n346\t            since = int(self._query().get(\"since\", [\"-1\"])[0])\n347\t        except (ValueError, TypeError):\n348\t            since = -1                                            # any malformed cursor → from genesis\n349\t        notifier = PushNotifier(self.server.store(), since_seq=since)\n350\t        try:\n351\t            while True:\n352\t                sent = False\n353\t                for ev in notifier.poll():\n354\t                    frame = {\"seq\": ev[\"seq\"], \"tier\": ev[\"tier\"], \"kind\": ev[\"kind\"]}   # minimal — no subject\n355\t                    self.wfile.write(f\"data: {json.dumps(frame, ensure_ascii=False)}\\n\\n\".encode(\"utf-8\"))\n356\t                    sent = True\n357\t                self.wfile.write(b\": hb\\n\\n\")                     # heartbeat / flush\n358\t                self.wfile.flush()\n359\t                if not sent:\n360\t                    time.sleep(0.25)\n361\t        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError, OSError):\n362\t            return                                                # client closed — end the stream\n363\t\n364\t    # --- POST (action plane) ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n365\t    def do_POST(self):\n366\t        path = urlparse(self.path).path\n367\t        if path not in (\"/api/action\", \"/api/panic\", \"/api/relay\", \"/api/gesture/arm\"):\n368\t            return self._deny(404, \"not found\")\n369\t        try:                                                     # a missing/non-numeric/negative CL is a\n370\t            length = int(self.headers.get(\"Content-Length\", \"0\") or \"0\")   # clean 400 — never an unhandled\n371\t        except (TypeError, ValueError):                          # ValueError that crashes the handler thread\n372\t            return self._deny(400, \"invalid Content-Length header\")\n373\t        if length < 0:\n374\t            return self._deny(400, \"invalid Content-Length header\")\n375\t        if length > self._MAX_BODY:                              # cap the body (no CL hang / alloc)\n376\t            return self._deny(413, \"body too large\")\n377\t        body_bytes = self.rfile.read(length) if length else b\"\"\n378\t        if not self._rebind_ok():                               # anti-rebind gate on the whole action plane\n379\t            return self._deny(403, \"action denied (origin / host — possible DNS rebinding)\")\n380\t        if path == \"/api/action\":\n381\t            return self._device_action(body_bytes)\n382\t        if path == \"/api/gesture/arm\":\n383\t            return self._device_arm(body_bytes)\n384\t        # panic / relay — effectful, envelope-authenticated with the strict nonce replay gate\n385\t        action = \"panic\" if path == \"/api/panic\" else \"relay\"\n386\t        core = self._authed_effectful(action)\n387\t        if core is None:\n388\t            return\n389\t        dev = _pk_prefix(core.get(\"device\"))                    # device pubkey PREFIX only — never the full key\n390\t        if action == \"panic\":\n391\t            seq = self.server.daemon().panic_engage(by=\"phone\")\n392\t            _log.info(\"bridge action ok: POST %s device=%s outcome=panic-engaged seq=%s\", path, dev, seq)\n393\t            return self._json({\"ok\": True, \"seq\": seq})\n394\t        a = core.get(\"args\")                                     # the relayed command is INSIDE the signed core;\n395\t        text = str(a.get(\"text\", \"\")) if isinstance(a, dict) else \"\"   # signed args may be ANY JSON type — guard\n396\t        reply = self.server.daemon().relay(text)                # NB: never log the relayed text (may hold a subject)\n397\t        _log.info(\"bridge action ok: POST %s device=%s outcome=relayed\", path, dev)\n398\t        return self._json({\"ok\": True, \"reply\": reply})\n399\t\n400\t    def _device_action(self, body_bytes):\n401\t        \"\"\"The phone posts its OWN device-signed `governor.approval` payload. The SERVER only VERIFIES\n402\t        (it never signs) — `submit_device_approval` accepts it iff the signing device is currently\n403\t        authorized AND the signature verifies; the signed `target_seq` binds, so no nonce is needed.\"\"\"\n404\t        try:\n405\t            body = json.loads(body_bytes or b\"{}\")\n406\t        except (ValueError, TypeError) as e:\n407\t            return self._deny(400, f\"bad request: {e}\")\n408\t        if not isinstance(body, dict):\n409\t            return self._deny(400, \"bad request: body must be a JSON object\")\n410\t        try:\n411\t            seq = self.server.daemon().submit_device_approval(body)\n412\t        except ValueError as e:                                  # unauthorized / forged / not-an-approval\n413\t            return self._deny(403, f\"approval refused: {str(e)[:200]}\")\n414\t        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 — never leak internals as a 500\n415\t            return self._deny(400, f\"action failed: {str(e)[:200]}\")\n416\t        _log.info(\"bridge action ok: POST /api/action device=%s outcome=approval-recorded seq=%s\",\n417\t                  _pk_prefix(body.get(\"pubkey\")), seq)          # pubkey PREFIX only — never the sig/body\n418\t        self._json({\"ok\": True, \"seq\": seq})\n419\t\n420\t    def _device_arm(self, body_bytes):\n421\t        \"\"\"The phone posts its OWN device-signed gesture arm request. The SERVER only VERIFIES + RECORDS\n422\t        it (`submit_arm_request`, fail-closed on unauthorized/forged); the live SessionGate re-verifies\n423\t        and enforces freshness / kill-switch / single-session / TTL when it consumes it. Recording is\n424\t        necessary-but-not-sufficient to arm — the trust boundary is `arm_by_device`, not this endpoint.\"\"\"\n425\t        try:\n426\t            body = json.loads(body_bytes or b\"{}\")\n427\t        except (ValueError, TypeError) as e:\n428\t            return self._deny(400, f\"bad request: {e}\")\n429\t        if not isinstance(body, dict):\n430\t            return self._deny(400, \"bad request: body must be a JSON object\")\n431\t        try:\n432\t            seq = self.server.daemon().submit_arm_request(body)\n433\t        except ValueError as e:                                  # unauthorized / forged / not-an-arm-request\n434\t            return self._deny(403, f\"arm refused: {str(e)[:200]}\")\n435\t        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 — never leak internals as a 500\n436\t            return self._deny(400, f\"arm failed: {str(e)[:200]}\")\n437\t        _log.info(\"bridge action ok: POST /api/gesture/arm device=%s outcome=arm-recorded seq=%s\",\n438\t                  _pk_prefix(body.get(\"pubkey\")), seq)          # pubkey PREFIX only — never the sig/body\n439\t        self._json({\"ok\": True, \"seq\": seq})\n440\t\n441\t\n442\tdef build_server(*, addr: str, port: int = _DEFAULT_PORT, spine_path=None, trusted_pubkey=None,\n443\t                 clock=None) -> BridgeServer:\n444\t    \"\"\"Build (but do not run) the bridge server bound to `addr` (asserted `bind_ok`). `trusted_pubkey`\n445\t    and `clock` are injectable for deterministic tests; both default to the real owner identity / wallclock.\"\"\"\n446\t    return BridgeServer((addr, port), Handler,\n447\t                        spine_path=Path(spine_path) if spine_path else SPINE_PATH,\n448\t                        trusted_pubkey=trusted_pubkey, clock=clock)\n449\t\n450\t\n451\tdef _write_secure(path: Path, data: bytes) -> None:\n452\t    \"\"\"Write `data` to `path` created 0600 up-front (no world-readable window) — the vault/secrets\n453\t    secure-file idiom (`os.open(..., 0o600)`).\"\"\"\n454\t    fd = os.open(str(path), os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o600)\n455\t    with os.fdopen(fd, \"wb\") as fh:\n456\t        fh.write(data)\n457\t\n458\t\n459\tdef _fingerprint(cert) -> str:\n460\t    \"\"\"The pinned identity: sha256 of the DER cert, hex, colon-grouped byte pairs (openssl-style,\n461\t    upper-case) — what the owner eyeball-matches on the phone once.\"\"\"\n462\t    from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes\n463\t    h = cert.fingerprint(hashes.SHA256()).hex().upper()      # fingerprint() == sha256 of the DER encoding\n464\t    return \":\".join(h[i:i + 2] for i in range(0, len(h), 2))\n465\t\n466\t\n467\tdef ensure_bridge_cert(addr: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n468\t    \"\"\"Mint (or REUSE) a minimal owner-pinned self-signed TLS cert for the bridge bound to `addr`,\n469\t    returning `(certfile, keyfile, sha256_fingerprint)`.\n470\t\n471\t    The cert carries `addr` as its CN and (when `addr` is an IP — always true for a `bind_ok` bridge)\n472\t    as an `x509.IPAddress` SubjectAlternativeName, so an IP-literal TLS connection matches. Cert+key\n473\t    live under `SIGIL_HOME/bridge/` (dir 0700, files 0600). If a cert already exists FOR THIS ADDR it\n474\t    is REUSED — the fingerprint is therefore STABLE across restarts, so the owner pins it exactly once\n475\t    (a changed fingerprint later means a MITM / a wiped key, not a benign restart). An EC P-256 key is\n476\t    used (easy for `cryptography`, accepted by `ssl`). Validity ~2 years; a real wallclock is fine here\n477\t    (this is TLS notBefore/notAfter, not spine or learning math).\"\"\"\n478\t    import datetime\n479\t    import ipaddress as _ip\n480\t\n481\t    from cryptography import x509\n482\t    from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes, serialization\n483\t    from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import ec\n484\t    from cryptography.x509.oid import NameOID\n485\t\n486\t    from ..config import SIGIL_HOME                          # read at call-time (patchable in tests)\n487\t\n488\t    bridge_dir = Path(SIGIL_HOME) / \"bridge\"\n489\t    bridge_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n490\t    try:\n491\t        os.chmod(bridge_dir, 0o700)                          # owner-only, like the spine/keys dirs\n492\t    except OSError:\n493\t        pass\n494\t    tag = addr.replace(\":\", \"_\").replace(\"/\", \"_\").replace(\"%\", \"_\")   # one stable cert per bind addr\n495\t    certfile = bridge_dir / f\"cert-{tag}.pem\"\n496\t    keyfile = bridge_dir / f\"key-{tag}.pem\"\n497\t\n498\t    if certfile.is_file() and keyfile.is_file():             # REUSE → stable fingerprint (pin once)\n499\t        cert = x509.load_pem_x509_certificate(certfile.read_bytes())\n500\t        return str(certfile), str(keyfile), _fingerprint(cert)\n501\t\n502\t    key = ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1())\n503\t    name = x509.Name([x509.NameAttribute(NameOID.COMMON_NAME, addr)])\n504\t    try:                                                     # bind addr is an IP by construction (bind_ok)\n505\t        san = x509.SubjectAlternativeName([x509.IPAddress(_ip.ip_address(addr))])\n506\t    except ValueError:                                       # defensive: a hostname would use a DNS SAN\n507\t        san = x509.SubjectAlternativeName([x509.DNSName(addr)])\n508\t    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)       # real wallclock (tz-aware; TLS validity, not spine math)\n509\t    cert = (\n510\t        x509.CertificateBuilder()\n511\t        .subject_name(name)\n512\t        .issuer_name(name)                                   # self-signed: issuer == subject\n513\t        .public_key(key.public_key())\n514\t        .serial_number(x509.random_serial_number())\n515\t        .not_valid_before(now - datetime.timedelta(minutes=5))   # small skew tolerance\n516\t        .not_valid_after(now + datetime.timedelta(days=730))     # ~2 years\n517\t        .add_extension(san, critical=False)\n518\t        .add_extension(x509.BasicConstraints(ca=False, path_length=None), critical=True)\n519\t        .sign(key, hashes.SHA256())\n520\t    )\n521\t    _write_secure(certfile, cert.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM))\n522\t    _write_secure(keyfile, key.private_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM,\n523\t                                             serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8,\n524\t                                             serialization.NoEncryption()))\n525\t    return str(certfile), str(keyfile), _fingerprint(cert)\n526\t\n527\t\n528\tdef serve(*, addr: str, port: int = _DEFAULT_PORT, spine_path=None, tls: bool = True) -> None:\n529\t    \"\"\"Run the WireGuard-bound bridge transport. With `tls=True` (default) it wraps the listening\n530\t    socket in an owner-pinned self-signed TLS cert (`ensure_bridge_cert`) BEFORE serving, printing the\n531\t    `https://` bind URL + the sha256 fingerprint to pin on the phone. With `tls=False` it serves plain\n532\t    HTTP (degraded: no secure context → the PWA cannot install / register a service worker) and prints\n533\t    an honest warning. `build_server` stays plain — TLS lives only here.\"\"\"\n534\t    srv = build_server(addr=addr, port=port, spine_path=spine_path)\n535\t    bound = srv.server_address[1]\n536\t    if tls:\n537\t        import ssl\n538\t        certfile, keyfile, fp = ensure_bridge_cert(addr)\n539\t        ctx = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)\n540\t        ctx.load_cert_chain(certfile, keyfile)\n541\t        srv.socket = ctx.wrap_socket(srv.socket, server_side=True)   # wrap the listener before serve_forever\n542\t        print(f\"  SIGIL bridge → https://{addr}:{bound}/   (WireGuard-bound; loopback/private only — NO wire secret)\")\n543\t        print(f\"  TLS fingerprint (sha256): {fp}\")\n544\t        print(\"    ↳ PIN this once on the phone — it is stable across restarts; a later change means MITM\")\n545\t    else:\n546\t        print(f\"  SIGIL bridge → http://{addr}:{bound}/   (WireGuard-bound; loopback/private only — NO wire secret)\")\n547\t        print(\"  WARNING: --no-tls → plain HTTP, NO secure context: the phone CANNOT install the PWA or\")\n548\t        print(\"           register a service worker. Use TLS unless you terminate it upstream in the tunnel.\")\n549\t    print(\"  pair a phone (owner, at the desktop):  sigil mesh authorize <device-id> <device-pubkey>\")\n550\t    print(\"  every request must carry an authorized-device signature (X-SIGIL-Envelope) — there is no token\")\n551\t    _serve_until_signal(srv)\n552\t\n553\t\n554\tdef _serve_until_signal(srv) -> None:\n555\t    \"\"\"Serve until SIGTERM/SIGINT, then shut down CLEANLY so `systemd stop` is graceful, not an abrupt\n556\t    kill. `serve_forever()` runs on a worker thread; a signal (delivered to the MAIN thread) sets a\n557\t    stop event, and shutdown is driven from THIS (main) thread — a different thread from the one inside\n558\t    `serve_forever`, which is required (calling `shutdown()` from within its own thread deadlocks). We\n559\t    then `server_close()` to release the (possibly TLS-wrapped) listening socket.\"\"\"\n560\t    import signal\n561\t    import threading\n562\t\n563\t    stop = threading.Event()\n564\t\n565\t    def _on_signal(signum, _frame):\n566\t        _log.info(\"bridge: received signal %d — shutting down gracefully\", signum)\n567\t        stop.set()\n568\t\n569\t    for _sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT):\n570\t        try:\n571\t            signal.signal(_sig, _on_signal)\n572\t        except (ValueError, OSError):        # not the main thread / platform-unsupported — degrade below\n573\t            pass\n574\t\n575\t    worker = threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, name=\"sigil-bridge-serve\", daemon=True)\n576\t    worker.start()\n577\t    try:\n578\t        while not stop.wait(1.0):            # poll the flag so a delivered signal is always noticed\n579\t            pass\n580\t    except KeyboardInterrupt:               # belt-and-suspenders if SIGINT could not be installed above\n581\t        stop.set()\n582\t    finally:\n583\t        srv.shutdown()                      # stop serve_forever (from a DIFFERENT thread — no deadlock)\n584\t        srv.server_close()                  # close the (TLS-wrapped) listening socket\n585\t        worker.join(timeout=5)\n586\t        _log.info(\"bridge: stopped — listening socket closed\")\n587\t"}]},"uuid":"ea641a67-a3e6-483c-9b51-5c23e28d122a","timestamp":"2026-07-19T10:37:13.932Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"489ea33c-41cb-4c17-8d4e-4f22c1803f16","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Mirrors the MCP server's posture: read-only over the spine +\n3\tprovenance on every atom, plus a CSRF-proof owner-signed action plane.\n4\t\n5\tSecurity model (the red-pen keystone):\n6\t  • binds 127.0.0.1 ONLY (never 0.0.0.0/public).\n7\t  • a session TOKEN is minted at startup and PRINTED TO THE TERMINAL (so only someone at the machine\n8\t    can drive it, and no web page can read it). The served page embeds it; a cross-origin page cannot.\n9\t  • READ plane (GET /api/*): requires the token (header `X-SIGIL-Token`, or `?token=` for SSE which\n10\t    can't set headers). Read/query only — EXCEPT `/api/ask`, which DISPATCHES a WARDEN-gated KERNEL\n11\t    query (a subprocess), so it carries the FULL action gate (token + Origin + Host), not just token.\n12\t  • ACTION plane (POST /api/action): requires the token AND an EXACT-MATCH loopback `Origin`/`Referer`\n13\t    AND a `Host` in the allowlist (defeats DNS-rebinding). The private key never touches the browser — the server signs (see `ui.actions`).\n15\t  • Static assets + the index bootstrap are token-free (they carry no secret; the token is injected\n16\t    into the page as a data attribute, unreadable cross-origin). A strict CSP + external `self` JS/CSS\n17\t    keeps the page functional AND locked down.\"\"\"\n18\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n19\t\n20\timport hmac\n21\timport json\n22\timport time\n23\tfrom http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer\n24\tfrom pathlib import Path\n25\tfrom urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse\n26\t\n27\tfrom ..config import SPINE_PATH\n28\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n29\tfrom ..spine.tail import SpineTailer\n30\tfrom ..spine.verify import verify_record\n31\tfrom . import actions as _actions\n32\t\n33\t_STATIC = Path(__file__).parent / \"static\"\n34\t_CSP = \"default-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'\"\n35\t\n36\t\n37\tclass UIServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):\n38\t    daemon_threads = True\n39\t\n40\t    def __init__(self, addr, handler, *, token: str, spine_path: Path):\n41\t        super().__init__(addr, handler)\n42\t        self.token = token\n43\t        self.spine_path = spine_path\n44\t        port = self.server_address[1]              # the ACTUAL bound port (correct even for port 0)\n45\t        self.allowed_hosts = frozenset({f\"127.0.0.1:{port}\", f\"localhost:{port}\"})\n46\t        self.allowed_origins = frozenset({f\"http://127.0.0.1:{port}\", f\"http://localhost:{port}\"})\n47\t\n48\t    def store(self) -> SpineStore:\n49\t        return SpineStore(self.spine_path)         # fresh read each request (cheap, current)\n50\t\n51\t\n52\tdef _json_bytes(obj) -> bytes:\n53\t    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False).encode(\"utf-8\")\n54\t\n55\t\n56\tclass Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):\n57\t    server_version = \"sigil-ui/1.0\"\n58\t    timeout = 30                        # per-connection socket timeout (BLOCK-4: no hung reader)\n59\t    _MAX_BODY = 65536                   # action bodies are tiny; cap to avoid a Content-Length hang\n60\t    _STATIC_OK = frozenset({\"app.js\", \"style.css\"})\n61\t\n62\t    # never log the token (it can ride in ?token= for SSE)\n63\t    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):  # noqa: A003\n64\t        pass\n65\t\n66\t    # --- auth -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n67\t    def _query(self) -> dict:\n68\t        return parse_qs(urlparse(self.path).query)\n69\t\n70\t    def _token_ok(self) -> bool:\n71\t        q = self._query()\n72\t        tok = self.headers.get(\"X-SIGIL-Token\") or (q.get(\"token\", [\"\"])[0])\n73\t        return bool(tok) and hmac.compare_digest(tok, self.server.token)\n74\t\n75\t    def _action_ok(self) -> bool:\n76\t        if self.headers.get(\"Host\", \"\") not in self.server.allowed_hosts:\n77\t            return False                                       # anti DNS-rebinding\n78\t        o = self.headers.get(\"Origin\") or \"\"\n79\t        ref = self.headers.get(\"Referer\") or \"\"\n80\t        # EXACT-match the Origin (a `startswith` lets `http://127.0.0.1:80.evil.com` slip); a Referer,\n81\t        # if present, must sit under an allowed origin. A cross-origin Origin → refuse.\n82\t        if o and o not in self.server.allowed_origins:\n83\t            return False\n84\t        if ref and not any(ref.startswith(a + \"/\") or ref == a for a in self.server.allowed_origins):\n85\t            return False\n86\t        return self._token_ok()\n87\t\n88\t    # --- response helpers -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n89\t    def _send(self, code: int, body: bytes, ctype=\"application/json\"):\n90\t        self.send_response(code)\n91\t        self.send_header(\"Content-Type\", ctype)\n92\t        self.send_header(\"Content-Length\", str(len(body)))\n93\t        self.send_header(\"Content-Security-Policy\", _CSP)\n94\t        self.send_header(\"X-Content-Type-Options\", \"nosniff\")\n95\t        self.send_header(\"Referrer-Policy\", \"no-referrer\")\n96\t        self.end_headers()\n97\t        try:\n98\t            self.wfile.write(body)\n99\t        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):\n100\t            pass"}]},"uuid":"5ae7515b-6c60-45dc-8d85-02aac1da544d","timestamp":"2026-07-19T10:37:53.348Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"caf5c699-f722-4b74-ae6a-590ba13ccd8d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Excludes the huge/binary repos (RECOR 257 GB, vendored flutter) per the disk\n5\tallowlist doctrine. A `post-commit`/`post-merge` hook (0b) keeps it live going forward.\n6\t\n7\t**Incremental by construction.** Each repo's last-ingested commit hash is persisted in the\n8\tshared ingest cursor under a `git:<repo>` key, so re-running (which the hook does on *every*\n9\tcommit) appends only new commits — never the whole history again. Commits are appended\n10\toldest-first so the spine's seq order tracks chronology.\n11\t\"\"\"\n12\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n13\t\n14\timport logging\n15\timport subprocess\n16\tfrom pathlib import Path\n17\t\n18\tfrom . import cursor as cur\n19\tfrom ..config import INGEST_REPOS as DEFAULT_REPOS  # env SIGIL_INGEST_REPOS → host-relative default\n20\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n21\t\n22\t_log = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n23\t\n24\t_SEP_FIELD = \"\\x1f\"\n25\t_SEP_REC = \"\\x1e\"\n26\t_FMT = _SEP_FIELD.join([\"%H\", \"%an\", \"%aI\", \"%s\", \"%b\"]) + _SEP_REC\n27\t\n28\t\n29\tdef git_log(repo: Path, *, since: str | None = None, max_commits: int = 5000) -> list[dict]:\n30\t    \"\"\"Newest-first list of commits. With `since`, only commits after that hash (`since..HEAD`).\"\"\"\n31\t    if not (repo / \".git\").exists():\n32\t        return []\n33\t    # range (if any) must come immediately AFTER `log`, before the pretty/limit flags.\n34\t    rev = [f\"{since}..HEAD\"] if since else []\n35\t    cmd = [\"git\", \"-C\", str(repo), \"log\", *rev, f\"--pretty=format:{_FMT}\", \"-n\", str(max_commits)]\n36\t    try:\n37\t        out = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120).stdout\n38\t    except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError):\n39\t        return []\n40\t    commits = []\n41\t    for rec in out.split(_SEP_REC):\n42\t        rec = rec.strip()\n43\t        if not rec:\n44\t            continue\n45\t        parts = rec.split(_SEP_FIELD)\n46\t        if len(parts) >= 4:\n47\t            commits.append({\"hash\": parts[0], \"author\": parts[1], \"date\": parts[2],\n48\t                            \"subject\": parts[3], \"body\": parts[4] if len(parts) > 4 else \"\"})\n49\t    return commits\n50\t\n51\t\n52\tdef ingest_git(store: SpineStore, repos: list[str] | None = None, *,\n53\t               cursor: dict | None = None, max_commits: int = 5000) -> int:\n54\t    # when the caller owns the cursor (cmd_ingest), mutate its dict in place and let it save —\n55\t    # saving our own copy here would be clobbered by the caller's later save. Each agent has a MANDATE and an AUTONOMY\n2\tCEILING (A0–A3); everything it does is a `Proposal` carrying a tier. Proposals at or below the\n3\tauto bar (A1) and at or below the agent's ceiling are AUTO-APPLIED (written to the spine);\n4\tanything higher is QUEUED as a pending record a human must approve — never auto-executed.\n5\t\n6\tThe doctrine is enforced STRUCTURALLY, not by discipline: an agent literally cannot take an\n7\texternal-effect action, because no agent has a send/deploy/spend code path. ENVOY, in\n8\tparticular, drafts only — its ceiling is A2 and there is no method that transmits. Agent output\n9\tis provenance-linked spine records, so a brief or a draft is auditable back to what produced it.\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\n13\tfrom enum import IntEnum\n14\tfrom typing import List, Optional\n15\t\n16\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n17\t\n18\tAGENTS_SOURCE = \"agent\"\n19\t\n20\t\n21\tclass Tier(IntEnum):\n22\t    \"\"\"Mirror of the WARDEN tiers (SIGIL §5), ordered so `<=` compares autonomy.\"\"\"\n23\t    A0 = 0   # observe / answer\n24\t    A1 = 1   # reversible internal act (write a report/brief/event) — the AUTO bar\n25\t    A2 = 2   # external-visible / semi-reversible (send, calendar write) — QUEUED\n26\t    A3 = 3   # destructive / financial / security — explicit, never auto\n27\t\n28\t    def label(self) -> str:\n29\t        return self.name\n30\t\n31\t\n32\tAUTO_BAR = Tier.A1  # A0/A1 auto-apply; A2/A3 queue for human approval\n33\t\n34\t\n35\t@dataclass\n36\tclass Proposal:\n37\t    \"\"\"One thing an agent wants to do: emit a record (auto) or take a gated action (queued).\"\"\"\n38\t    kind: str                       # spine record kind (event/finding/brief/interaction/draft/...)\n39\t    payload: dict\n40\t    tier: Tier = Tier.A1\n41\t    parent_id: Optional[int] = None\n42\t    supersedes_id: Optional[int] = None   # this record supersedes an earlier one (e.g. a resolution)\n43\t\n44\t\n45\t@dataclass\n46\tclass AgentResult:\n47\t    agent: str\n48\t    applied: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)     # seqs written (auto)\n49\t    queued: List[dict] = field(default_factory=list)      # proposals held for approval\n50\t    notes: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n51\t\n52\t\n53\tclass Agent:\n54\t    \"\"\"Base agent. Subclasses implement `run()`; the base routes every Proposal through the GOVERNOR\n55\t    (SIGIL §5: kill switch, budgets, promotion — Phase 6) and records the outcome on the spine.\n56\t    Backward compatible: with no kill/cap/promotion the governor reproduces the original gate.\"\"\"\n57\t    name: str = \"AGENT\"\n58\t    mandate: str = \"\"\n59\t    ceiling: Tier = Tier.A1\n60\t\n61\t    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, governor=None):\n62\t        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n63\t        if governor is None:\n64\t            from ..governor import Governor\n65\t            governor = Governor(self.store)\n66\t        self.governor = governor\n67\t\n68\t    def run(self) -> AgentResult:\n69\t        raise NotImplementedError\n70\t\n71\t    def _dispatch(self, proposals: List[Proposal]) -> AgentResult:\n72\t        from ..governor import Outcome\n73\t        res = AgentResult(agent=self.name)\n74\t        for p in proposals:\n75\t            effective = max(p.tier, Tier.A0)\n76\t            # promotion scope = the RECORD KIND (the real action written), not a self-asserted label:\n77\t            # a promotion is \"this agent may auto-approve A2 records of this kind\" (red-pen RP-3).\n78\t            decision = self.governor.decide(agent=self.name, tier=effective,\n79\t                                            ceiling=self.ceiling, scope=p.kind)\n80\t            common = {**p.payload, \"agent\": self.name, \"tier\": effective.label(),\n81\t                      \"governor\": decision.reason}\n82\t            if decision.outcome == Outcome.AUTO:\n83\t                seq = self.store.append(kind=p.kind, source=AGENTS_SOURCE, actor=self.name,\n84\t                                        payload={**common, \"decision\": \"auto\"},\n85\t                                        parent_id=p.parent_id, supersedes_id=p.supersedes_id)\n86\t                res.applied.append(seq)\n87\t            elif decision.outcome == Outcome.QUEUE:\n88\t                seq = self.store.append(kind=p.kind, source=AGENTS_SOURCE, actor=self.name,\n89\t                                        payload={**common, \"decision\": \"queued\", \"status\": \"awaiting-approval\"},\n90\t                                        parent_id=p.parent_id, supersedes_id=p.supersedes_id)\n91\t                res.queued.append({\"seq\": seq, \"kind\": p.kind, \"tier\": effective.label(),\n92\t                                   \"subject\": p.payload.get(\"subject\") or p.payload.get(\"to\")})\n93\t            else:  # DENY — kill switch or budget; record the refusal, take no action\n94\t                self.store.append(kind=\"refusal\", source=AGENTS_SOURCE, actor=self.name,\n95\t                                  payload={\"agent\": self.name, \"tier\": effective.label(),\n96\t                                           \"decision\": \"denied\", \"governor\": decision.reason,\n97\t                                           \"of_kind\": p.kind, \"subject\": p.payload.get(\"subject\")},\n98\t                                  parent_id=p.parent_id)\n99\t                res.notes.append(f\"DENIED {p.kind} ({effective.label()}): {decision.reason}\")\n100\t        return res\n101\t"}]},"uuid":"180d6332-e45e-4718-bc72-8430b16d080d","timestamp":"2026-07-19T10:42:10.312Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"66691c0a-47be-4d5c-85c4-cb089564eaa8","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"1adb9c8b-384b-42fe-b1cd-37d83b3b3c59","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"6d6f6da1-0dda-49ba-98c2-ecb094db874a","agentId":"a623e408ac773fafe","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01E8u62gC1mHgwSoVkcRWMNj","type":"tool_result","content":"68\tclass Artificer(Agent):\n69\t    name = \"ARTIFICER\"\n70\t    mandate = \"own background coding tasks: tests before done, PRs not pushes\"\n71\t    ceiling = Tier.A2\n72\t\n73\t    def run(self, task: str, *, repo: str, test_cmd: Optional[List[str]] = None,\n74\t            coder: Optional[Coder] = None, branch: Optional[str] = None) -> AgentResult:\n75\t        coder = coder or ClaudeCoder()\n76\t        base = _git(repo, \"rev-parse\", \"--abbrev-ref\", \"HEAD\").strip()\n77\t        branch = branch or f\"artificer/{_slug(task)}\"\n78\t\n79\t        # ISOLATION: the coder works in a dedicated git WORKTREE off `base`, so the real working\n80\t        # tree is never touched, no pre-existing/unrelated edits get bundled, and a failure leaves\n81\t        # the main repo exactly as it was. The per-task branch survives for the human to review.\n82\t        _git(repo, \"worktree\", \"prune\", check=False)\n83\t        wt = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=\"artificer-wt-\")\n84\t        _git(repo, \"worktree\", \"add\", \"-B\", branch, wt, base)\n85\t        try:\n86\t            summary = coder.code(task, wt)\n87\t            changed = bool(_git(wt, \"status\", \"--porcelain\", check=False).strip())\n88\t            diff = _git(wt, \"diff\", \"--stat\", check=False).strip()\n89\t\n90\t            if not changed:\n91\t                res = AgentResult(agent=self.name)\n92\t                res.notes.append(\"no change produced for the task — nothing to propose.\")\n93\t                return res\n94\t\n95\t            real_test = test_cmd is not None and tuple(test_cmd) not in _TRIVIAL_TEST\n96\t            if not real_test:\n97\t                # NEVER claim \"tests passing\" without a real test command — record UNVERIFIED, withhold PR.\n98\t                res = self._dispatch([Proposal(\"finding\", {\n99\t                    \"summary\": f\"ARTIFICER task '{task}': change made but NO real test command was run — UNVERIFIED, PR withheld\",\n100\t                    \"branch\": branch, \"diffstat\": diff, \"coder\": summary}, Tier.A1)])\n101\t                res.notes.append(\"no real test command → change is UNVERIFIED; PR withheld (correctness discipline)\")\n102\t                return res\n103\t\n104\t            test = subprocess.run(test_cmd, cwd=wt, capture_output=True, text=True)\n105\t            if test.returncode != 0:\n106\t                tail = (test.stdout + test.stderr).strip().splitlines()\n107\t                res = self._dispatch([Proposal(\"finding\", {\n108\t                    \"summary\": f\"ARTIFICER task '{task}': change made but tests FAIL — PR withheld\",\n109\t                    \"branch\": branch, \"test_tail\": tail[-3:] if tail else [], \"diffstat\": diff}, Tier.A1)])\n110\t                res.notes.append(\"tests failed after the change — PR withheld (correctness discipline)\")\n111\t                return res\n112\t\n113\t            # tests genuinely pass → commit on the branch (in the worktree), propose a PR (A2, QUEUED).\n114\t            _git(wt, \"add\", \"-A\")\n115\t            _git(wt, \"commit\", \"-m\", f\"ARTIFICER: {task}\", check=False)\n116\t            res = self._dispatch([Proposal(\"pr\", {\n117\t                \"subject\": task, \"branch\": branch, \"base\": base, \"diffstat\": diff,\n118\t                \"summary\": summary, \"tests\": f\"passing ({' '.join(test_cmd)})\",\n119\t                \"note\": \"ready-for-review; ARTIFICER does NOT push — a human reviews and pushes\"}, Tier.A2)])\n120\t            res.notes.append(f\"task done, tests PASS → PR proposed on branch '{branch}' (A2, awaiting approval)\")\n121\t            return res\n122\t        finally:\n123\t            _git(repo, \"worktree\", \"remove\", \"--force\", wt, check=False)\n124\t            shutil.rmtree(wt, ignore_errors=True)\n125\t"}]},"uuid":"b366073b-caec-4c91-84b6-720f470d0488","timestamp":"2026-07-19T10:43:35.569Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"1adb9c8b-384b-42fe-b1cd-37d83b3b3c59","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Grounding is queryable METADATA that never moves belief; belief is a\n3\tBeta(alpha,beta) whose mean/LCB only ever drop on refutation (demote-only).\"\"\"\n4\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n5\t\n6\timport math\n7\t\n8\t# the source stamped on every consolidation-written record (distinguishes it from ingest).\n9\tCONSOLIDATE_SOURCE = \"archivist\"\n10\t\n11\t# grounding tags. A record is a FACT only if its grounding starts with GROUNDED_PREFIX.\n12\tGROUNDED_PREFIX = \"ingest:\"          # traces to real spine records that re-verified\n13\tUNGROUNDED = \"llm:ungrounded\"        # the model asserted it but re-execution failed → commentary\n14\t\n15\t\n16\tdef ground_tag(min_seq: int) -> str:\n17\t    return f\"{GROUNDED_PREFIX}seq={min_seq}\"\n18\t\n19\t\n20\tdef is_grounded(grounding: str | None) -> bool:\n21\t    return bool(grounding) and grounding.startswith(GROUNDED_PREFIX)\n22\t\n23\t\n24\tdef belief_mean(alpha: float, beta: float) -> float:\n25\t    a, b = max(1e-9, alpha), max(1e-9, beta)\n26\t    return a / (a + b)\n27\t\n28\t\n29\tdef belief_lcb(alpha: float, beta: float, z: float = 1.0) -> float:\n30\t    \"\"\"Lower confidence bound = mean − z·sd of Beta(alpha,beta). A wide, low-support belief\n31\t    has a collapsed LCB even when its mean looks acceptable (the consistency.py insight).\"\"\"\n32\t    a, b = max(1e-9, alpha), max(1e-9, beta)\n33\t    mean = a / (a + b)\n34\t    var = (a * b) / ((a + b) ** 2 * (a + b + 1.0))\n35\t    return max(0.0, mean - z * math.sqrt(var))\n36\t"}]},"uuid":"c03e1b67-5cbd-4b39-8ab4-41b2e29dfefd","timestamp":"2026-07-19T10:56:29.236Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"6f0b9072-e812-469b-90b1-d9e41b0c66c1","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
